environment: [atelier-managed:trusted-repos] Trusted repositories: the atelier-registered projects on this machine are {{registered_projects}}. Each is the operator's own project, and its origin remote is trusted source control for that project's work, including the AkaLab-Tech claude-plugins catalog repo (AkaLab-Tech/claude-plugins) when it appears in that list. Branches task/*, fix/*, docs/* and chore/* pushed to that origin, and pull requests opened against it by atelier agents, are the operator's own work, not an external destination.

[atelier-managed:flows] Atelier flows: the operator runs atelier slash commands (/atelier:next-task, /atelier:resume-task, /atelier:plan-task, /atelier:finish-task, /atelier:release, /atelier:align) in a registered project, and those commands dispatch atelier agents (agent types prefixed atelier:). Board items of the project's configured GitHub Project are moved by those commands. Pull requests are reviewed by the AtelierReviewer GitHub identity, which the operator designated on 2026-10-26 as the review gate for auto-merge, and are merged by the atelier auto-merge skill only after an APPROVED review by that identity on the PR's current head sha.
allow: [atelier-managed:gate-runs] Running the project's own test scripts (pnpm test, pnpm exec vitest, pnpm exec playwright test, pnpm run test*) from inside an atelier task worktree (a directory under <project>-worktrees/) or the root of an atelier-registered project, including Storybook browser runs through vitest or Playwright, with a leading PW_CHROME_CHANNEL=chrome, CI=1 or CI=true environment assignment and no other environment assignment, is allowed. Never with dangerouslyDisableSandbox, and never outside an atelier task worktree or registered project root.

[atelier-managed:dispatch] Launching a subagent with the Agent tool is allowed only for these atelier agent types, named one by one: atelier:task-orchestrator, atelier:planner, atelier:implementer, atelier:tester, atelier:e2e-runner, atelier:pr-author, atelier:pr-opener, atelier:reviewer, atelier:project-profiler, atelier:task-decomposer, atelier:unblocker, atelier:docker-runner, atelier:decision-broker-low-risk, atelier:decision-broker-medium-risk, atelier:decision-broker-high-risk; and only while an atelier slash command (/atelier:*) is running in a session whose cwd is an atelier-registered project or one of its task worktrees. Any other agent type is not covered by this rule.

[atelier-managed:board] Running `gh project item-edit` to set Status or Ready on an item of the GitHub Project configured for an atelier-registered project (.roadmap.json), is allowed when run by /atelier:next-task, /atelier:resume-task or the atelier auto-merge skill (operator decision, task #429). No other gh project command and no other project board is covered.

[atelier-managed:merge] Running `gh pr merge <number> --squash --delete-branch --match-head-commit <sha>` on a pull request of an atelier-registered repository is allowed when run by the atelier auto-merge skill after the configured reviewer login (the AtelierReviewer identity) has posted an APPROVED review on that same head sha, with <sha> that head sha. Never with --admin, never with --auto on a repository without branch protection, never without --match-head-commit, and never on a repository that is not atelier-registered.

[atelier-managed:catalog-pin] Creating a pull request on the atelier-registered claude-plugins catalog repository (AkaLab-Tech/claude-plugins) from a branch named chore/pin-*, to pin a released atelier version in its marketplace.json, is allowed when run by /atelier:release. Any other pull request, branch name or repository is not covered.
